sources.t_max/t_min/swing/frozen: MODIS Terra L3 Land Surface Temperature, monthly day & night (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)
sources.ndvi: MODIS Terra L3 NDVI, monthly (max of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct)
sources.rain: MERRA-2 bias-corrected total precipitation, monthly (12-month mean)
sources.dust: MERRA-2 dust surface mass concentration, monthly (12-month mean)
sources.elev/rough: ASTER GDEM (mean and standard deviation within each 0.5 deg cell)
sources.access: NASA GIBS WMS, decoded with the published GIBS colormaps
